name: Spitan Spirits Expedition -in the Phantasmagoria-
original_name: スピたん Spirits Expedition―in the Phantasmagoria―
source:
There’s a mountainous crag to the northeast of the Continent of Dragons called Dragon's Claw Marks. No one in the recorded history has been able to cross that area safely. However, they did not have a newly invented airship!

You play as the aspiring and newly appointed captain of this vessel, Loty Eiblyss, but you didn’t exactly come with your own crew of hardened sailors. In fact it’s more like a rowdy well-to-do family of women posing as a crew, coupled with an actual lady sword master (your teacher) and an another mysterious girl. At least this family of nine women appears to be trained to fight when the need arises.

[Edited from a forum post quoting White Masq]

The crew Loty Eiblyss leads is made of the sub-spirits from the Rakios Spirit Corps that Yuuto led in Eien no Aselia.
translation:
龙之大陆东北部有一片名为“龙爪痕”的险峻山区。有史以来，从未有人能够安全穿越那里。不过，过去的人可没有新发明的飞空艇！

玩家将扮演这艘飞空艇新上任、满怀抱负的船长洛蒂·艾布利斯。遗憾的是，你并没有一群久经风浪的水手可供差遣。所谓船员，更像是一个吵吵闹闹、家境优渥的女性大家庭，再加上一名真正的女剑术大师——你的老师——以及另一名神秘少女。好在这个由九名女性组成的“家庭”，似乎都受过必要时投入战斗的训练。

[改编自一篇引用White Masq的论坛帖子]

洛蒂·艾布利斯率领的船员，正是《永远的艾塞莉娅》中由悠人指挥的拉奇欧斯精灵部队所属下位精灵。
